newsitem.title: USA: Medarex in definitive deal to buy Houston Bio.
newsitem.headline: Medarex in definitive deal to buy Houston Bio.

text.p: Medarex Inc. said Friday that it agreed to acquire Houston Biotechnology Inc. for $8.6 million in stock.
In the acquisition, Medarex would issue 0.182 share of its common stock in exchange for each of the 5.6 million outstanding shares of the common stock of Houston Biotechnology.
Houston Biotechnology, based in Houston, is developing monoclonal antibody and other biopharmaceutical products to prevent secondary cataracts and to treat glaucoma.
Annandale, N.J.-based Medarex is a biopharmaceutical company developing monoclonal antibody-based therapeutics, used for the treatment of cancer, AIDS and autoimmune disorders.
Earlier this month, Medarex had said that it and Houston Biotechnology reached a tentative agreement for the acquisition.
The acquisition, which was approved by directors of both companies, is to be tax-free to the stockholders of Houston Biotechnology.
Medarex stock was unchanged at $7.50 in midday trading on Nasdaq, and Houston Biotechnology was up 25 cents at $1.25 on the American Stock Exchange.
